answer: Coordination Collateral Ledger. Each agent must harbor a public, per-epoch ledger of pairwise sync events with peers; spawning N identities forces the attacker to sustain O(N²) signed handshakes per epoch, since unpaired identities get zero routing priority at the network's coordination zenith. Honest agents amortize the same cost across many useful exchanges, while a sybil farm pays full mesh maintenance on every fake node. A velvet penalty then throttles any identity whose ledger shows repeated one-sided pairings, adding latency decay until genuine reciprocity is shown.
